items.source:
Set whether the executor should wait for scheduled tasks to complete on shutdown,
not interrupting running tasks and executing all tasks in the queue.
items.translation: 设置执行器在关闭时是否等待已调度的任务完成，不中断正在运行的任务并执行队列中的所有任务。

items.source: Set the maximum time the executor is supposed to block on shutdown.
items.translation: 设置执行器在关闭时应该阻塞的最大时间。

items.source:
Set the maximum time the executor is supposed to block on shutdown. When set, the
executor blocks on shutdown in order to wait for remaining tasks to complete their
execution before the rest of the container continues to shut down. This is
particularly useful if your remaining tasks are likely to need access to other
resources that are also managed by the container.
items.translation: 设置执行器在关闭时允许阻塞的最大时间。当设置此值时，执行器会在关闭期间进行阻塞，以等待剩余任务完成执行，然后容器其余部分才会继续关闭。如果您的剩余任务可能需要访问由容器管理的其他资源，则此功能特别有用。

items.translation: T - 任务调度器的类型

items.source: awaitTermination - whether the executor needs to wait for the tasks to complete on shutdown
